message.content: {"hts_code": "1604.30.2000", "reason": "Both products are prepared seafood mixtures containing squid, shrimp, mussels, clams and octopus that are cooked/frozen in retail packs, and under HTSUS Chapter 16 prepared or preserved fish/crustacean/mollusc products (heading 1604 covering prepared seafood, with squid as the predominant component in subheading 1604.30 for prepared squid) are classified in 1604.30 as prepared squid, with the 10-digit statistical suffix 2000 applied to the retail-packed prepared squid products."}

predicted_reason: Both products are prepared seafood mixtures containing squid, shrimp, mussels, clams and octopus that are cooked/frozen in retail packs, and under HTSUS Chapter 16 prepared or preserved fish/crustacean/mollusc products (heading 1604 covering prepared seafood, with squid as the predominant component in subheading 1604.30 for prepared squid) are classified in 1604.30 as prepared squid, with the 10-digit statistical suffix 2000 applied to the retail-packed prepared squid products.
